video.title: AI欧腐《公爵的俘虏狼骑士/His Captive Wolf》
video.desc:
His Captive Wolf is a romantic fantasy BL story set in the grand Valmond Grand Duchy. At ten, young heir Astor rescues wolf‑clan boy Kane and takes him as his shadow bodyguard. Fourteen years pass, Kane grows into a silent, formidable knight, while Astor gradually realizes his deep, possessive love for him. Faced with forced political marriage pressure, Astor casts aside noble decency to pursue his loyal knight. Amid court gossip, family conflicts and power plots, the pair break rigid master‑servant barriers, fight for their bond, and finally gain recognition to rule the duchy side‑by‑side for a lifelong devotion.
《公爵的俘虏狼骑士》是一部背景设定在广大瓦尔蒙德公国的浪漫奇幻BL作品。十岁时，年轻的公国继承人亚斯托救下了狼族少年凯恩，将他收为自己的影卫贴身护卫。十四年过去，凯恩成长为沉默寡言、实力强大的骑士，亚斯托也逐渐察觉到自己对他怀有深沉且带有占有欲的爱意。面对强制政治联姻的压力，亚斯托抛开贵族的体面规矩，主动追求自己忠诚的骑士。在宫廷流言、家族冲突与权力斗争的阴谋之中，两人打破了严格的主仆界线，为彼此的羁绊奋战，最终获得所有人的认可，并肩统治公国，拥有了一生不渝的感情。
